list.notConnected: Your site is not connected yet. Approved articles wait for you to download them, or you can connect your site in Settings.

generating.title: We are writing this article
generating.body: This usually takes one to three minutes. You can leave this page; we will email you when it is ready.

notWritten.title: This article is not written yet
notWritten.body: We start writing automatically a few days before the publishing date. You can also start now.
notWritten.quotaFull: You have used all articles for this month. New articles are available next month.

errors.ai_not_configured: Article writing is not available because the AI service is not set up.
errors.ai_budget: We reached today's AI limit. We will try again tomorrow, or you can try later.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI service was busy. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.ai_blocked: The AI service refused to write about this topic. Try a different title or keyword.
errors.ai_invalid_output: The draft did not come out right. Please try writing it again.
errors.quota_exceeded: You have used all articles for this month.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.publish_auth_failed: Your site did not accept our login. Reconnect your site in Settings; it takes about 30 seconds.
errors.publish_forbidden: The connected user is not allowed to publish. Reconnect with an editor or administrator account.
errors.publish_not_found: We could not find your site's publishing address. Check the connection in Settings.
errors.publish_not_wordpress: We could not reach the WordPress publishing interface. Check the connection in Settings.
errors.publish_app_passwords_disabled: Application passwords are turned off on your WordPress site. Turn them on and reconnect.
errors.publish_unreachable: We could not reach your site. We tried several times; please check that it is online and publish again.
errors.publish_rejected: Your site rejected the article. Check the connection, then publish again.
errors.publish_server_error: Your site answered with an error several times. Please publish again later.
errors.publish_internal: Publishing failed on our side. Please publish again.
errors.publish_no_blog: We could not find a blog in your store. Create a blog in Shopify, then publish again.
errors.publish_no_author: Your Wix site no longer has a member who can be the author. Add a member, then publish again.
errors.publish_invalid_mapping: The fields of your Webflow collection changed. Connect it again in Settings.
errors.duplicate_post: One of your posts already covers this topic.

review.googlePreview: How it may look in Google
review.verificationNone: This article has no specific numbers or dates to check.
review.verificationUnchecked: We could not check the facts automatically. Please review numbers and dates before approving.
review.coverGenerated: The cover was created from your brand colors.
review.infographicCaption: Infographic: added after the first section when published. You can also share it on social media.
review.coverSite: The cover uses the image from the page on your site closest to this topic.

reject.title: Why are you rejecting this article?
reject.body: We take your answer into account when we write it again and in your next articles.

status.scheduledConnected: Approved. It will be published on {{date}}.
status.scheduledNow: Approved. It is being published now.
status.scheduledNotConnected: Approved. Your site is not connected: download the article and publish it yourself, or connect your site.

seoChecks.keyword_in_meta_description: Focus keyword in the Google description
seoChecks.keyword_in_intro: Focus keyword in the first paragraph
seoChecks.keyword_density: Natural use of the focus keyword

connections.title: Site connection
connections.body: Approved articles are published straight to your website, including the cover image.
connections.disconnectBody: Approved articles will no longer be published automatically. Your login details are deleted. You can connect again at any time.

wordpress.label: WordPress
wordpress.hint: Publishes posts with the cover image as featured image.

webhook.label: Webhook (custom website)
webhook.hint: We send each article as signed JSON to your developer's address.

ghost.label: Ghost
ghost.hint: With an Admin API key; the cover becomes the feature image.

shopify.label: Shopify
shopify.hint: Publishes articles to your store's blog.

webflow.label: Webflow
webflow.hint: To your CMS collection; you map the fields.

wordpress.appPasswordHint: In WordPress go to Users → Profile → Application Passwords. Enter a name such as “Kitisel”, click “Add”, then paste the password here.

webhook.urlHint: Must start with https://. We send each article as JSON with an HMAC signature.
webhook.secretBody: Use it to check that requests come from Kitisel (header X-Upvine-Signature). We will not show it again.

errors.auth_failed: Your site did not accept the login details. Check them and try again.
errors.forbidden: This user is not allowed to publish posts. Use an editor or administrator account.
errors.not_found: We could not find this address. Check it and try again.
errors.not_wordpress: We could not find WordPress at this address. Check the address, or ask your developer whether the REST API is turned off.
errors.app_passwords_disabled: Application passwords are turned off on this WordPress site. The site must use HTTPS, and no security plugin may block them.
errors.unreachable: We could not reach this address. Check it and try again.
errors.rejected: The site rejected our test request. Check the address and try again.
errors.server_error: The site answered with an error. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.no_blog: Your store has no blog. Create one in Shopify under Online Store → Blog posts.
errors.no_author: Your Wix site has no member who can be the author. Add the Members Area and add yourself as a member.
errors.invalid_mapping: The chosen fields don't fit the collection (the body must be a rich text field and all required fields must be mapped).

callback.failed: We could not connect WordPress. Please try again or enter an application password.
callback.rejected: The connection was not approved in WordPress.

ghost.adminApiKeyHint: In Ghost Admin go to Settings → Integrations → "Add custom integration", then copy the "Admin API key" and paste it here.

shopify.shopHint: For example mystore.myshopify.com (you see it in the address bar of your Shopify admin).

app.label: Shopify app (recommended)
app.hint: Create an app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard, install it on your store and enter its Client ID and Client secret.

token.label: Legacy custom app token
token.hint: If you have a custom app created before 2026: its Admin API token starting with "shpat_".

shopify.scopes: The app needs these permissions: write_content (blog articles) and write_files (images).

webflow.tokenHint: In Webflow go to Site settings → Apps & Integrations → API access → "Generate API token". Allow read and write for CMS, Sites and Assets.
webflow.noCollections: We found no CMS collection this token can access.
webflow.mapHint: Choose the field for each part of the article. The title and slug always go to the "Name" and "Slug" fields.

wix.apiKeyHint: Create a new key on the "API Keys" page of your Wix account and give it Blog and Media Manager permissions.
wix.siteIdHint: The long ID after "/dashboard/" in the address bar of your site's dashboard.
wix.authorNote: Wix requires posts to be published by a site member: we use the first member as the author.

editor.title: Edit post
editor.saved: Saved. The SEO score was recalculated.
editor.conflict: This post was saved somewhere else while you were editing. Copy your changes, reload the page and apply them again.
editor.slugHint: The post address. Don’t change it after publishing.
editor.bodyHint: The table of contents, FAQ and structured data update automatically when you save.

unsaved.title: Changes not saved
unsaved.body: If you leave now, your unsaved changes will be lost.

rewrite.title: Rewrite this part
rewrite.body: The selected part is rewritten. Your post doesn’t change until you review and accept the result.
rewrite.nothingSelected: First select the text to rewrite, or place the cursor inside a section.
rewrite.customHint: For example: "Don’t mention prices, invite readers to book an appointment."
rewrite.tooLong: The selected part is too long. Select a smaller part.

versions.title: Version history
versions.body: Every save is a separate version. Going back to an old version doesn’t delete the history.

cover.title: Change cover image
cover.description: Upload an image you made. It isn’t cropped, and your cover is kept even if the article is rewritten.
cover.fileHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF; at least 600×300 pixels, up to 10 MB. 1600×900 (16:9) works best.
cover.altHint: Briefly describe what the image shows. Google and screen readers use it.
cover.invalid: This file can’t be used. Choose a JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF of at least 600×300 pixels and up to 10 MB.

duplicate.title: Your site already covers this topic
duplicate.body: We didn’t write a new article because one of your posts already covers this topic. Two posts on the same topic weaken each other on Google. We suggest updating the existing post instead:
